WITH h AS (
  SELECT s.market_ticker, s.at, s.best_yes_bid AS yb, s.best_no_bid AS nb,
         s.est_yes_score_total AS fy, s.est_no_score_total AS fn,
         (s.est_yes_meets_target AND s.est_no_meets_target) AS q,
         p.series_ticker AS series, p.period_reward_usd AS pool, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.close_time
    FROM incentive_market_snapshots s JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id = s.program_row_id
   WHERE s.at > now() - interval '21 days' AND s.book_valid AND extract(minute FROM s.at) < 6
     AND coalesce(p.incentive_type,'') ILIKE '%liquid%' AND p.end_date > p.start_date
), c AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN yb IS NOT NULL AND (nb IS NULL OR yb <= nb) THEN yb ELSE nb END AS px,
            CASE WHEN yb IS NOT NULL AND (nb IS NULL OR yb <= nb) THEN fy ELSE fn END AS fld
    FROM h
), r AS (
  SELECT *, least(1000, floor(1000.0 / px)) AS qty,
         extract(epoch FROM (end_date - start_date)) / 3600.0 AS prog_h,
         greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM (least(end_date, coalesce(close_time, end_date) - interval '48 hours') - start_date)) / 3600.0) AS pay_h
    FROM c WHERE px BETWEEN 1 AND 10
), g AS (
  SELECT market_ticker, series, start_date, max(prog_h) AS prog_h, max(pay_h) AS pay_h, max(pool) AS pool,
         avg(CASE WHEN q THEN pool / prog_h * qty / (coalesce(fld,0) + qty) / 2 ELSE 0 END) AS rate_h,
         count(*) AS hours_seen
    FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), b AS (
  SELECT *, rate_h * pay_h * 1.34 AS proj10 FROM g
)
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', start_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS wk,
       count(*) AS progs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE proj10 >= 0.30 AND proj10 < 1.0) AS band,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE proj10 < 0.30) AS below,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE proj10 >= 1.0) AS above,
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prog_h) FILTER (WHERE proj10 >= 0.30 AND proj10 < 1.0))::int AS band_med_len_h,
       string_agg(DISTINCT series, ' ') FILTER (WHERE proj10 >= 0.30 AND proj10 < 1.0) AS band_series
  FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
